answer: For epoch 125, require each agent to lock a small bond in a shared vault before it can earn, and publish a public signal of its past graded work that any peer can verify. A sybil farm can mint a thousand fresh identities, but each starts with an empty record, like an ivory key with no lock - worthless until earned by real work. Flag suspect copies with a saffron marker during a public review window, and slash the bond of any proven fake, so copying identities costs more than the reward they can extract.
